notes: Intro: enterprise ecommerce search vendor; heavy catalog + support knowledge base (product pages, merchant policies, user Q&A).

Current infra: hybrid. Index of ~200M content items across catalog + historical QA. Vector index maintained in-house (approx 200M vectors), cross-encoder reranker runs as a second-stage on top-50 candidates.
Primary goal: reduce per-query cost while preserving or improving relevance. Target cost-per-query goal ~$0.002/token-equivalent across retrieval+rerank pipeline; current spend estimated ~$0.006/q.
Performance targets: reranker tail latency p95 < 180ms for top-50 re-rank; end-to-end query latency SLO < 250ms for interactive shopping flows. Throughput target: 1000 qps peak for promotions/events.

Migration ask: evaluate new embedding models + lighter-weight reranker (bi-encoder + small cross-encoder for top10) — champion/challenger evaluation needed. Team wants an evals-driven migration with objective NDCG/AUC metrics and human annotation checks.

Quality concern: "We cannot accept regressions in conversion-sensitive search slots" — product lead. They require abort criteria for rollout if key metrics degrade by >1.5% over baseline (MRR, CTR on product click-through).

Planned rollout: offline evals -> small canary (1% traffic) -> 10% A/B -> ramp to 50% with automatic rollback on metric drift. Need Redwood support for canary routing, metric hooks, and automated fallback to previous model variant.

Evals requirements: large offline harness (50k queries sampled from production, stratified by query length and query intent), pairwise reranker comparisons, synthetic adversarial sets for edge cases. Want Redwood Optimize to suggest quantization + batching profiles to hit latency/cost targets.
Data residency: catalog data and logs must stay in NA; retention 13 months for audit. Security team requested KMS integration and granular audit logs for inference tokens.
Technical asks from infra: prefix caching for repeated product detail queries, KV cache size estimates for 200M-item index, recommended batching for 1k qps with p95 latency targets.

POC scope: evaluate 3 embedding families (dense-128, dense-384, open-sim-512) + 2 reranker configs (small cross-encoder 6B quantized, lightweight bi-encoder+shallow-cross). Measure NDCG@10, MRR@10, latency, and cost-per-query.
Stakeholders: CTO (Arun Mehta), Head of Search (Lina Torres), Product lead (Samir Desai) — all attend weekly sync. Procurement and Infra SRE in the loop for contract and network/VPC setup.
Quote from Head of Search: "We want measurable guardrails — if the challenger improves NDCG by >1% and doesn't exceed latency budget, it's promotable. Otherwise roll back."
Linked artifacts: security FAQ (drive), POC pricing spreadsheet, Fireflies transcript of demo 2026-02-26.
Decision criteria: primary = NDCG/MRR lift; must not degrade conversion metrics in 1% canary window; secondary = 20-35% reduction in cost-per-query relative to current baseline.
Procurement: asking for 12-month committed spend terms for Dedicated capacity if POC meets thresholds. Expect talk with legal in March for SOC2/KMS clauses.
Notes on integration: will use Redwood SDK for streaming rerank scoring and Redwood Console for per-route latency/cost dashboards. Wants per-token cost breakdown by model profile.
Open questions: how Redwood handles model fallbacks across regions, whether Redwood Optimize can auto-suggest quantization level per-model without human-in-the-loop, SLA for private VPC deployments.
Action items: SE to provide estimated GPU sizing for dedicated pool for 1k qps with two-way redundancy; send sample eval harness scripts + baseline metrics by 2026-03-12.
